borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description:
Conversion of the
C3 dwelling into two 2xbed flats including construction of a single storey rear
extension
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:11pt">The proposed development results in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the identified need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Whilst the proposal would create 2x dwellings,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">neither of them would comply with the </span><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">minimum internal space standards required to ensure adequate </span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">quality of accommodation for future occupants thus it is considered to be at the&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">detriment of the existing high-quality family dwellinghouse</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11pt; text-align: justify;">As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's supply of family housing and is contrary to the following policies:</span></p><ul><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">National Planning Policy Framework (August 2026);</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policies D6, H9 and T4 of the London Plan (March 2021); and</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policies DMD1, DMT1, DMH5, SP3 and SP8, of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></li></ul>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The proposal fails to meet the required minimum space standards for the overall GIA and built-in storage for both of the proposed flats and one of the single bedrooms on the ground floor and one of the ground floor single bedrooms would not benefit from a window&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">to provide natural daylight and ventilation.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11pt;">It would therefore provide a substandard quality of accommodation detrimental to the standard of living of future residents. Therefore, the proposal fails to comply with:&nbsp;</span></p><ul><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">National Planning Policy Framework (August 2026); </span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policy D6 of the London Plan (March 2021);&nbsp;</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Policy DMH5 of&nbsp; The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024);&nbsp; and&nbsp;</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:11pt">Technical housing standards – nationally described space standard (March 2015)</span></li></ul>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The proposed development fails to demonstrate that additional demand for parking from the development could be adequately accommodated in the surrounding area.&nbsp; especially as the application site does not benefit from high levels of access to public transport, and is within the&nbsp;J Controlled Parking Zone (CPZ) . The proposal is therefore likely to exacerbate existing parking stress within the CPZ thus add unacceptably to parking stress and congestion in the vicinity of the application site. &nbsp;As such, it fails to comply with the following policies which seek to ensure proposals show how car parking will be designed and managed and to take into consideration on-street parking availability and existing and planned public transport provision:- National Planning Policy Framework (August 2026)- Policies T1, T2, T3, T4, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies DMD1, DMT2 and SP8 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></p>
